name: Tuathmhumhain
text: Tuathmhumhain is the Modern Irish spelling of the name Thomond. The dictionary prints the head as a one-line cross-reference. It points to North Munster under that anglicized name. The fuller record of the O'Brien kingdom sits under the Thomond node.
